<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Pendulum Wave — Canvas Simulation</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;min-height:100%;box-sizing:border-box;background:#0c0c10;color:#ececf0;font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;overflow:hidden}
  *{box-sizing:border-box}
  body{position:fixed;inset:0}
  #stage{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;cursor:pointer}
  #hud{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;z-index:5;max-width:min(560px,calc(100vw - 20px));padding:10px 14px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(14,14,20,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
  #hud h1{margin:0 0 7px;font-size:15px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:.02em}
  #hud h1 .accent{color:#7ee7ff}
  .row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 16px;align-items:center}
  .ctl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:12px;color:#b9b9c6}
  .ctl label{white-space:nowrap}
  .ctl b{min-width:38px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#fff;font-weight:650}
  input[type=range]{accent-color:#38c9e8;width:118px;height:18px;cursor:pointer;margin:0}
  button{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;border:1px solid rgba(126,231,255,.35);background:rgba(126,231,255,.08);color:#aef0ff;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s,transform .05s;font-family:inherit}
  button:hover{background:rgba(126,231,255,.18)}
  button:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
  #stats{margin-top:7px;font-size:11px;color:#8f8fa0;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  #stats .hint{color:#6b6b7a;font-variant-numeric:normal}
